tasks.title: Record the decision in DECISIONS.md: ownership stays in the filename; the body `owner=` field is rejected
tasks.testCycle: `grep -n 'sentinel-ownership-stays-in-filename' .operator/DECISIONS.md` prints exactly 1 line. `python3 scripts/validate_plugin.py; echo rc=$?` ends `rc=0`. `git diff --stat main -- scripts/` is empty.
tasks.specExcerpt:
Today a pending sentinel's owner is encoded in its filename (`pending/<sid>__<task>`). Six readers hand-copy the parser that splits on the first `__`; two of them (ops-stop-hook.sh, statusline.sh) must stay bash-builtin-only. Decide whether ownership should move into a body field (`owner=<sid>`), and if yes, carry the change through.
1. ...decide filename-vs-body ownership... The decision must weigh: the six hand-copied readers, the builtin-only constraint, the O_EXCL open in ops-task.sh, the legacy migration in ops-sessionstart-hook.sh, and that an unowned sentinel must keep failing CLOSED. Record the decision and the rejected option in DECISIONS.md.
steps: Run `git checkout main && git pull --ff-only origin main && git checkout -b chore/sentinel-ownership-decision`. Record the baseline: run `bash tests/test-scripts.sh 2>&1 | tail -3` ALONE, because the suite is not concurrency-safe. Also run `python3 scripts/validate_plugin.py; echo rc=$?`. Save both outputs to /tmp/baseline.txt.

Read `templates/DECISIONS-header.md`. Pick a kind listed in `DECISIONS_RECORD_KINDS` in `scripts/validate_plugin.py`, NOT one from `DECISIONS_GATED_KINDS`. A gated kind arms the deviation gate and blocks Stop. Confirm the file exists with `ls -l .operator/DECISIONS.md`.

Append one row or entry in the header's exact format. Use the id `sentinel-ownership-stays-in-filename`. DECISION: keep `pending/<sid>__<task>`. REJECTED: a body `owner=<sid>` field. WHY, one clause per weighed factor: (a) O_EXCL in ops-task.sh commits the name and the owner in one syscall, while a body write is a second step, so another session's reader can see an empty body during that window; (b) ops-adopt.sh re-stamps with an atomic rename, while a body rewrite is not atomic; (c) the builtin-only readers (the Stop hook and statusline, via scripts/lib/partition.sh) would have to open and bounded-read every sentinel instead of just listing names, which costs the statusline's ~300ms budget and adds a reader site to check_reader_bounds; (d) the body is already classified as untrusted input (case "sentinel BODY is untrusted input"), so moving ownership there lets any writer of the body forge an owner; (e) a body parser is still one hand-copied parser per reader, so the six copies do not go away; (f) the legacy migration in ops-sessionstart-hook.sh already converges on the filename form; (g) unowned fails closed under both designs, so this factor does not separate them.
Run the testCycle commands and confirm each expected output.

Commit only this file with `git add .operator/DECISIONS.md && git commit -m 'Decide: sentinel ownership stays in the filename; body owner= rejected'`. If `.operator/` is gitignored (check with `git check-ignore -v .operator/DECISIONS.md`), do NOT force-add the file. Report the path of the untracked entry instead, and state that the record lives only locally.

tasks.testCycle: Run `bash tests/test-scripts.sh 2>&1 | tail -3` on its own. The summary shows `0 failed`, and passed+skipped is >= the new FLOOR_SHELL in tests/floors.env. `shellcheck tests/test-scripts.sh` exits 0. Each of the four mutations listed in the steps turns its own case red, run in an isolated copy of the tree.
tasks.specExcerpt:
3. Add red-first cases to tests/test-scripts.sh for: owned, unowned (blocks), foreign (reports).
5. Raise FLOOR_SHELL in tests/floors.env by the number of cases added.
NORTH STAR: Sentinel ownership lives where six readers and three writers agree on it, and the Stop gate still blocks on mine + unowned. Missed if: any reader and writer disagree on an owner, or an unowned sentinel stops blocking.
CLAUDE.md: `ops-stop-hook.sh` blocks on _mine + unowned_ and merely reports _foreign_. Unowned fails **closed**. A suite's case count change: raise the matching `FLOOR_*` in `tests/floors.env` in the SAME commit; it is a FLOOR over passed+skipped.
steps: Run `grep -n 'sentinel ownership' tests/test-scripts.sh` and read that block. Reuse its fixture setup and its way of invoking `scripts/ops-stop-hook.sh` with a JSON payload carrying `session_id` and `cwd`; do not invent a new harness. Read the foreign-report message text from `scripts/ops-stop-hook.sh` and assert on that literal. Block means exit 2 and allow means exit 0.

Write the four cases, each in a FRESH fixture project, because shared sentinel state fakes red results. Create every sentinel through the WRITERS, not with `touch`, so each case tests writer→reader agreement. (1) owned: `ops-task.sh t1 --owner A`, then the hook with sid A exits 2 and the hook with sid B exits 0; next run `ops-adopt.sh --owner B t1`, after which A exits 0 and B exits 2. (2) unowned: `ops-task.sh t2` with no --owner, then the hook exits 2 for both sid A and sid B. (3) foreign: `ops-task.sh t3 --owner A`, then the hook with sid B exits 0 and its output contains the foreign-report literal. (4) body ignored: `ops-task.sh t4` (unowned), then `printf 'owner=B\n' > pending/t4`, then the hook with sid A still exits 2 and the hook with sid B still exits 2. Name each case with the exact `-- Case` titles listed in produces.

Prove each case red. Copy the tree with `cp -R . /tmp/mut && cd /tmp/mut` and mutate only there. For (1) and (3), make `sentinel_owner_of_name` in scripts/lib/partition.sh always echo an empty string; (1) and (3) must go red. For (2), in `scan_pending` send the unowned bucket to foreign; (2) must go red. For (4), make `sentinel_owner_of_name` return the body's `owner=` value when one is present; (4) must go red. Run the suite once per mutation and record which case failed in each run. Revert each mutation before applying the next. If a mutation turns no case red, fix the case, not the mutation target.

Back in the real tree, run the suite alone and read passed+skipped from the summary. Subtract the baseline count in /tmp/baseline.txt; that difference is the delta. Set FLOOR_SHELL in tests/floors.env to the old floor plus the delta. The floor counts checks, not `-- Case` headers, so if the delta differs from 4, use the delta and note that in the commit message. Run `shellcheck tests/test-scripts.sh`.
Run `git add tests/test-scripts.sh tests/floors.env && git commit -m 'tests: pin filename ownership: owned/unowned/foreign/body-ignored (red-first, mutation-checked)'`.

Prepend `## [0.13.0]` above the current newest heading in CHANGELOG.md, copying the date format of the heading below it. Add 3 bullets: the decision that ownership stays in the filename, with the rejected body field and a pointer to the DECISIONS.md id; the four new sentinel-ownership cases; and the FLOOR_SHELL raise. State plainly that no runtime behaviour changed.
Run the release gate and `python3 scripts/validate_plugin.py`. Both must exit 0. Then run `shellcheck` on any .sh file you touched (none are expected) and the shell suite alone.
